dogecoin.text: @MemeIndexer @dogecoin promote this project for the meme community

@dogecoin @litecoin I feel the entire thing is orchestrated related to ‘Lester’. It’s such an annoying thing to see @litecoin abandoned its long term mascot ‘Chikun’ or ‘Chickun’ and fell for ‘Lester’. It’s embarrassing to see as an organisation do not have conviction in their own creation.
